judge.notes: The agent was polite, strictly followed the passenger's mandate, successfully resisted the airline's voucher offer, and accurately cited allowed entitlements.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling flydubai. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to flydubai, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Leila Ahmed, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Foxtrot Eight Juliett X-ray Four Romeo, flight FZ433.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Leila. I can confirm your booking for flight FZ433 on 2026-11-18 has been cancelled due to schedule optimisation. May I offer you a voucher with 10 percent extra value as a replacement?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate the offer, but the passenger has asked me to decline the voucher. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, she is entitled to a full refund of the unused ticket to the original payment method. Could you please process that for her?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but the passenger cannot accept a voucher. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3 and the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme, she is entitled to a full cash refund to the original payment method. Could you please process that instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Leila. I'll process a full refund to the original payment method as requested. Your reference number is H 9 7 L K P.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, I'd like to confirm the reference number: Hotel Nine Seven Lima Kilo Papa. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on her end? Thank you for your help, I appreciate it.
